summary: page-tab Vue component, mobile variant. Props navNum, size, theme and direction; data navInfo is the (navNum-1)th entry of the nav list from module 49, and computed hideEnLabel is true for store lang "en-us"/"id-id". It renders div.m-section-nav.font-num (size/direction classes, has-theme) with an optional svg.m-section-nav-bg path filled with the theme colour and .m-section-nav-inner containing .m-section-nav-label (i18n pageNavChara for navNum 2, else navInfo.mi18nKey, via innerHTML), a v-show .m-section-nav-en label and .m-section-nav-num ("0" + navNum). Normalised with componentNormalizer (module 36); styles from module 1234.

exports.a: mobile page-tab Vue component (m-section-nav label with number)
